raw_text: Is anyone else unable to make UPI payments this morning? PhonePe, GPay, Paytm all failing for me. Checked with friends across different banks and SBI, HDFC, ICICI all affected. This seems like a NPCI-level issue. Some reports on Twitter suggesting a possible DDoS attack on the payment infrastructure.
clean_text: Widespread UPI payment failures across PhonePe, GPay, Paytm affecting multiple banks. NPCI-level infrastructure issue suspected with possible DDoS attack reports.
